## Loading necessery libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
```

## Uploading raw data:

```{r}
raw_data <- read_csv("_raw/GSE162746_Raw_counts_collected.csv")
head(raw_data)
```

## Data cleaning

### Table 1 metadata

#### This table will contain all the samples experimental conditions.

```{r}
#Metadata is in the first 4 rows of the original data
metadata <- raw_data[1:4, 1:ncol(raw_data)]
head(metadata)
```

```{r}
#Lets rename the 1 column, later we will transpose the table:
metadata[1,1] <- "Sequence_ID"
metadata[2,1] <- "Time"
metadata[3,1] <- "Stimulus"
metadata[4,1] <- "Donor"
metadata
```

```{r}
#Lets create names for the columns - original id for smaples so sample_1......sample_last_column_number
colnames(metadata) <- c(
  "Samples",
  paste0("sample_", 1:(ncol(raw_data) - 1))
)
metadata

```

```{r}
#Lets transpose the data and use first row as header:
metadata <- as.data.frame(t(metadata))

# Check the result
head(metadata)

```

```{r}
# Assign first row as column names
colnames(metadata) <- as.character(metadata[1, ])
metadata <- tibble::rownames_to_column(metadata, var = "Samples")

# Remove first row
metadata <- metadata[-1, ]
head(metadata)
```

```{r}
#Lets change how the Stimulus is written for easier further analysis using _ instead of -, RPMI - is control group
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(across(everything(), str_trim)) |>
  mutate(
    Stimulus = recode(Stimulus,
      "RPMI"                  = "Control_group",
      "Candida-albicans"      = "C_albicans",
      "Aspergillus-fumigatus" = "A_fumigatus",
      "Rhizopus-oryzae"       = "R_oryzae"),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("4h", "24h"))
  )

head(metadata)
```

### Table 2 Gene count matrix

#STILL NEEDS TO BE DONE

```{r}

```

# 3. Gene count matrix: keep only Ensembl gene rows

counts \<- raw \|\> filter(str_starts(row_id, "ENSG")) \|\> rename(gene_id = row_id) \|\> mutate(across(-gene_id, \~ as.integer(str_trim(.x))))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(counts\$gene_id), !anyNA(counts))

# 4. Select Candida and RPMI, and give each sample a readable name

selected \<- sample_info \|\> filter(stimulus %in% c("C_albicans", "unstimulated")) \|\> mutate(group = if_else(stimulus == "C_albicans", "Candida", "RPMI")) \|\> arrange(group, time, donor) \|\> group_by(group) \|\> mutate( sample_no = row_number(), new_name = paste0("Sample", sample_no, "\_", group) ) \|\> ungroup()

# 5. Metadata tables, one per group

candida_meta \<- selected \|\> filter(group == "Candida") \|\> select(sample_id, time, donor, new_name)

rpmi_meta \<- selected \|\> filter(group == "RPMI") \|\> select(sample_id, time, donor, new_name)

print(candida_meta, n = 20) print(rpmi_meta, n = 20)

# 6. Count matrix with the readable column names

counts_named \<- counts \|\> select(gene_id, all_of(selected$sample_id)) |>  rename_with(  ~ selected$new_name\[match(.x, selected\$sample_id)\], .cols = -gene_id )

# 7. Save

dir.create("data_clean", showWarnings = FALSE) write_csv(counts_named, "data_clean/counts_candida_rpmi.csv") write_csv(candida_meta, "data_clean/metadata_candida.csv") write_csv(rpmi_meta, "data_clean/metadata_rpmi.csv") write_csv(selected, "data_clean/metadata_all_selected.csv") \`\`\`
